description: This file is a hardware abstraction layer header for STM32F4 microcontrollers, specifically defining RAM functions related to flash memory operations for the STM32F4xx series. It declares prototypes for functions that manipulate flash interface clock and sleep mode, possibly to be used in firmware that manages flash memory operations at a low level.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_StopFlashInterfaceClk
methods.description: Stops the flash interface clock, potentially to save power or prepare for certain flash operations.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_StartFlashInterfaceClk
methods.description: Starts or resumes the flash interface clock to enable flash operations.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_EnableFlashSleepMode
methods.description: Enables sleep mode for the flash interface to reduce power consumption.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_DisableFlashSleepMode
methods.description: Disables sleep mode for the flash interface, restoring normal operation.
